minimum_comparison_recommendation: Align with supervisor DESIGN_DECISION.md: compare the single full-support Plackett-Luce ordered-top-three distribution Q_T(i,j,k) built from F1_STYLE6 raw scores at T=1 versus one positive scalar T fitted by race-equal exact 1->2->3 joint NLL on 2019-2023 OOS raw scores. Keep the same saved score vintage in both arms; do not apply calibration tau fitted on the same label year. Evaluate the fixed 2024-2026-09-19 cohort as repeated development data and derive each locked wager event probability by summing this same Q. The current primary comparison is T=1 vs fitted T, not HY_R_FORM. Existing HY_R_FORM evidence is the 2026 common 467-race comparison only (no 2025 comparison), so treat it as prior context or a separate future question. Do not use odds/ROI or add relationship/order heads to this minimum comparison.
